change: Replace all three Get-NetTCPConnection listener queries in the WebDriver probe with read-only IP Helper IPv4/IPv6 OWNER_PID_LISTENER observations. Preserve loopback, owning PID, process creation and cleanup guards.

failure_evidence.observation: CDP version available; PowerShell Get-NetTCPConnection launch check timed out after 10 seconds before journey steps. Final owned-process and listener cleanup was empty. This does not establish a product behavior failure.

api_contract.abi: 32-bit DWORD; IPv4 row 24 bytes; IPv6 row 56 bytes; table row offset from ctypes structure alignment
api_contract.bounds: At most four calls per family, 16 MiB table allocation; reject API errors, invalid growth, returned-size/count boundary violations and non-LISTEN rows. No partial-family success or unknown-as-empty fallback.
api_contract.latency_boundary: Eliminates PowerShell/CIM startup. Retry count and allocation are bounded; a synchronous Windows API call has no independent wall-clock cancellation guarantee.

validation.synthetic: API errors in both families, growth/retry bounds, malformed tables and counts, ABI layout, two-family target filtering, wildcard/unowned/recycled PID rejection and exception propagation
validation.real: Windows self-owned temporary IPv4 127.0.0.1 and IPv6 ::1 sockets: listener appears with exact address/port/current PID, then disappears after close. Both real tests ran without skip.
validation.qualification_boundary: Local probe/helper regression only. No native rebuild, product launch, installed journey, cloud CI, Owner-machine/Green qualification, commit or push performed by this task.

rollback: Revert the three probe replacements and remove the dedicated helper, test and this receipt as one scoped change.
